name: Expanding Input
blurb: A search icon that becomes the field, and collapses back when cleared.
mechanism: Two halves in one control: a button and a field, with `hidden` deciding which is shown. The field grows from nothing on the way in via `@starting-style`, which gives a first frame to transition away from - `display: none` alone has no box to animate.
caveats: Four lines of JavaScript to move focus into the field on open. Without them the icon still expands, it just does not focus, and a keyboard user has to tab into it.
The collapsed state is an icon button, so it needs an aria-label - a magnifying glass is not a name.
support: `[hidden]` and a width transition, nothing newer.
